title: krn lane run installs dependencies with the contract install command in a fresh worktree
body:
Why: src/cli/lane-run.ts has no install step (lead-verified); contract.install exists (src/repo/contract.ts:179). A fresh pilot worktree has no node_modules, so every check fails at worktree and base alike. Pilot blocker for t-djnrw3t.
Evidence: .krn/runs/state-review/decisions.md (state review 2026-11-13, Fable 5.2; data verified by the lead where noted), .krn/runs/state-review/portability-probe.md.
Source: operator 2026-11-13 ordered the state-review decisions executed ('lecisz z tym wszystkim').
